Method of Attack: Local File Inclusion (LFI) vulnerability in Kibana Console plugin allowing upload of malicious script and potential remote code execution
Execution of arbitrary JavaScript code via Kibana Console API leading to arbitrary command execution with Kibana process permissions
Attack Vector: Access to Kibana Console API to send malicious requests
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept exploit code targeting password directory, credentials dumped in Kibana log
